answers.core: As this is a problem that arises as soon as you want your perfect RNG in the second shader, or share a very fragile list of inputs, it would be better to have this problem solved out of the box.
answers.workaround:
Paste your libraries in every file or have a precompiler to do that automatically, after some effort.
Alternatively put all your compute in a single file with a massive switch in main.

title: Add `#include` preprocessor support to GLSL compute shaders
